neighbours.label: the verb 'create' (create, created, creates, creating) when it means bringing about an abstract outcome such as problems, opportunities, momentum or a mood, as against verbs that remove or end such outcomes in the same sentences
fire: Rapid growth in the suburbs created long delays for commuters every morning.
Experts believe the new railway line will create opportunities for small towns.
The bright murals in the hallway create a cheerful mood for patients.
Years of mistrust between the two clubs created tension before every match.
Analysts argue that cheaper loans could create a bubble in the housing market.
The surprise resignation of the mayor created confusion at city hall.
Soft lighting and quiet music help create a sense of calm in the shop.
Critics warned that the vague wording would create loopholes for tax evaders.
quiet: Rapid growth in the suburbs reduced long delays for commuters every morning.
Experts believe the new railway line will end isolation for small towns.
The bright murals in the hallway removed a gloomy mood for patients.
Years of talks between the two clubs eased tension before every match.
Analysts argue that tighter loans could prevent a bubble in the housing market.
The quick statement from the mayor cleared confusion at city hall.
Soft lighting and quiet music help reduce stress in the shop.
Critics warned that the vague wording would close loopholes for tax evaders.

predictions: fire 0.5-0.9 on ' create(d/s)' with an abstract object; the same sentences with solved, reduced, ended or removed below 0.1
notes: Card: ' created' x11, ' create' x7, ' made' x3, ' cast' (a terror) x1, always with an abstract result object; the + pole is ' give'. Probe: 'created serious problems' 0.917, 'will create thousands of jobs' 0.533, 'create a calm, dreamy atmosphere' 0.561; 'caused serious problems' 0.305 (a causal near-synonym leaks), 'solved' 0.006, 'create a new account' 0.004 (literal software sense is quiet), noun 'creation' 0.001. Near misses use verbs that remove outcomes, so the 'caused' leak is not tested.
